about: GTA 6's mountain, Mount Kalaga: Rockstar's own page calls it 'A national landmark up against the state’s northern border' that 'offers prime hunting, fishing, and off-road trails', with 'hillbilly mystics and paranoid radicals' in the backwoods 'far from the prying eyes of the government' (rockstargames.com/VI/only-in-leonida/kalaga, read 2026-11-01). No real-world comparison (the Florida beat was cut after jury round 2: it only lands if Leonida = Florida, which Rockstar never says). The film never gives Mount Kalaga a height: Rockstar's site doesn't. Ends on an open one-word question that loops into line 1. GTA 6 launches November 19, 2026 on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. Delta.

lines.say: G T A 6 has a mountain.

lines.text: A national landmark up against the state's northern border.
Plus prime hunting, fishing, and off-road trails.
And in the backwoods? Hillbilly mystics and paranoid radicals.
Far from the prying eyes of the government.
But Rockstar's site never gives its height.
So, mountain or hill? One word.
